title: The priest's blessing physically opens the barrow doors hours before the barrow is even entered ('Far off, the stone doors grind open. No promise binds them shut.'), even though the reeve's quest text promises 'you decide at the throne' - the later throne-side choice does still register as its own decision, but the early line briefly reads as if the outcome were already locked in.
where: Gray Chapel / 'a blessing for the barrow', paid off later at Throne of the Barrow / 'leave the barrow open to the sky'
